summary:
Long-duration space missions expose astronauts to critical occupational hazards, including cosmic radiation, microgravity fluid shifts, isolation, and hostile closed environments. Named in honor of Dr. René Favaloro, pioneer of cardiovascular surgery. FAVALORO SpaceHealth is an autonomous, non-invasive health monitoring platform designed to provide astronaut crew self-assessment without relying on opaque "black-box" AI algorithms for critical clinical decisions.
The platform operates across three integrated core layers:
Continuous Telemetry Ingestion: Real-time tracking of physiological vital signs (heart rate, SpO2, blood pressure, body temperature, blood glucose).
Deterministic Clinical Rule Engine: Transparent, evidence-based triage applying NASA-aligned thresholds to categorize status into Green, Amber, or Red alerts.
Cabin Smart Mirror: Passive, zero-friction facial biomarker monitoring (facial edema index, colorimetry/paleness ratio, ocular fatigue) captured during daily crew hygiene routines.
Built around NASA Spaceflight Standard Measures and addressing the HRP 5 Spaceflight Hazards, FAVALORO SpaceHealth pairs a Next.js 15 / React 19 frontend with an offline-first FastAPI + SQLite architecture. Features include an interactive Anatomy Map, vital signs dashboard, trend analytics, and medical supply inventory management, ensuring crew safety on lunar and Martian exploration missions.
details:
What does it do and how does it work?

FAVALORO SpaceHealth provides real-time crew health assessment and early risk detection for deep-space missions. The system ingests wearable telemetry and smart mirror visual biomarkers, routing them through an offline-first FastAPI backend with an SQLite database. It displays health data across dedicated modules: an interactive Anatomy Map Panel, real-time Vital Signs Monitor, multi-metric Interactive Charts, NASA Standard Measures Logs (actigraphy, cognitive battery, behavioral mood, sensorimotor stability), and a Cabin Smart Mirror view. Every reading is evaluated by a deterministic clinical rule engine into intuitive Green (Normal), Amber (Caution), or Red (Critical) statuses.

What benefits does it have and what is the intended impact?

  • Operational Medical Autonomy: Operates 100% offline aboard the spacecraft, overcoming deep-space communication latency (up to 22 minutes to Mars).
  • Zero-Friction Monitoring: Passive visual scanning via the Cabin Smart Mirror tracks fluid shifts (facial edema) and fatigue without adding crew operational burden.
  • Transparent Safety: Eliminates AI hallucination risks by using deterministic clinical rule evaluation.
  • Mission Impact: Directly mitigates risks associated with NASA's 5 Spaceflight Hazards (radiation, isolation, distance from Earth, altered gravity, closed environments) during Artemis and future Mars missions.

What tools, coding languages, hardware, or software did you use?

  • Frontend: Next.js 15, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Material Symbols, Google Fonts (Manrope, Space Grotesk).
  • Custom Interactive Components: AnatomyMapPanel (interactive body status mapping), VitalSignsPanel (real-time telemetry), InteractiveChartsPanel (trend analytics), DailySummaryKPIPanel, kpiData evaluator module.
  • Backend: Python (FastAPI), Uvicorn server, SQLite (lightweight, offline-first database), REST API endpoints (/api/tripulantes, /api/telemetria, /api/analitica, /api/botiquin).
  • Architecture: Next.js API Proxy for seamless communication (/api/* → http://localhost:8000/api/*).

How is your project creative?

Rather than treating astronaut monitoring as static data entry, FAVALORO SpaceHealth transforms NASA Spaceflight Standard Measures into an active, interactive crew experience. It creatively merges passive computer vision (Smart Mirror) with continuous wearable telemetry and interactive body-mapping visualization (AnatomyMapPanel), bridging raw biometrics with human-centered space medical design.

What factors did your team consider?

  • Deep-Space Offline Reality: Local SQLite and offline-first backend ensuring 100% availability without Earth cloud dependency.
  • Astronaut Experience: Minimal cognitive load through color-coded status badges (Green/Amber/Red) and mobile-responsive layouts.
  • Medical Supply Tracking: Integrated onboard medical kit inventory (/api/botiquin) to match detected health alerts with available countermeasures.
